**Implementation note:** Fixed-width-window fractional differencing.

## Description

Applies fractional differencing to reduce nonstationarity while retaining more long-memory information than ordinary differencing.

## Where it may fit

Feature engineering for predictive models where raw price levels are nonstationary but differencing removes too much information.

## Vehicles

ML-driven equity, futures, FX and crypto strategies; a feature pipeline, not an independent signal.

## Required data

Price/feature histories, fractional differencing order and threshold, transformation parameters fit on training data only.

## Caveats

Preprocessing alone creates no alpha; tune differencing only within training folds and avoid data leakage.
